name: videospeed
description: A modern, private, dependency-free video speed controller for Chromium browsers.
author: Ahmad Awais

scripts.check: node --check extension/lib.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/popup.js && node --check extension/options.js
scripts.icons: for s in 16 32 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s assets/icon.svg -o extension/icons/icon$s.png; done
